messages:
Nina R: starting a small PR to add a concise provisioning quickstart for Dedicated capacity. Focus: minimal steps to get a tenant up, an autoscale policy example, and a short note on isolation behaviors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2103
Owen T: nice. can you keep the quickstart under one page? we should avoid deep historical details. reviewers will want a clear path: create pool -> assign tenant label -> apply scale policy -> confirm metrics.
Nina R: yep planning a single page with anchors. question for infra: in examples should we show tenantLabel: "team-acme" or tenantId: "acme-123"? we use both in codepaths and want the doc to match runtime best-practice.
Priya S: use tenantLabel in the example. tenantId is an internal identifier and often not available to customer engineers. also call out that label values must match the tenant registry pattern.
Owen T: add a short note about eviction semantics: isolation evictions happen when pool-level resource pressure > threshold; include the link to runtime isolation doc (internal) and suggest an observable (eviction_count) metric.
Nina R: added a Troubleshooting section: "Evicted tenants: check eviction_count, verify pool limits, consider moving tenant to reserved pool."
Priya S: autoscale suggestion: show minReplicas/maxReplicas and recommend a scale-down cooldown of 6m for most workloads because model cold-starts and KV cache warmup skew immediate metrics. put that as a suggested default, not a hard requirement.
Nina R: added example snippet inline: scalePolicy: minReplicas: 2, maxReplicas: 10, cooldownSeconds: 360. Keeping it inline avoids code fence noise in mobile views.
Infra Bot: Note: Burst pools may preempt work under cluster pressure. Recommend including a one-line distinction in the SLA appendix.
Nina R: appended a small SLA appendix: Reserved pools: lower preemption risk; Burst pools: opportunistic capacity and possible preemption. kept wording plain.
Docs Bot: Reminder: please add a changelog entry and a short description for the sidebar nav (Docs taxonomy).
Nina R: added changelog entry and nav label. requesting reviews from @Owen T and @Priya S.
Owen T: reviewed, two copy nits around "tenant label" phrasing. pushed tiny edit. :tiny_pencil:
Priya S: approved. left a comment to follow up with a parametrized Terraform snippet in a separate PR (so this quickstart stays concise).
Nina R: merged. filing follow-up ticket to add terraform snippet + expanded metrics section. thanks all.
